test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following schemes will yield maximum discount on purchase of ₹x?

1) 2 successive discounts of 25% and 15%

2) Single discount of 20%

3) 2 free on purchase of 3 items

4) 3 free on purchase of 7 items
solution:
**Given:**

Price of item = ₹x

**Formula Used:**

For successive discounts: Final Price = Initial Price × (1 - discount1) × (1 - discount2)

For single discount: Final Price = Initial Price × (1 - discount)

For free items on purchase: Effective price per item = Total Price / Total Items Received

**Calculation:**

1) Two successive discounts of 25% and 15%

Final Price = ₹x × (1 - 0.25) × (1 - 0.15)

Final Price = ₹x × 0.75 × 0.85

Final Price = ₹x × 0.6375

Discount = ₹x - ₹x × 0.6375

Discount = ₹x × (1 - 0.6375)

Discount = ₹x × 0.3625

2) Single discount of 20%

Final Price = ₹x × (1 - 0.20)

Final Price = ₹x × 0.80

Discount = ₹x - ₹x × 0.80

Discount = ₹x × (1 - 0.80)

Discount = ₹x × 0.20

3) 2 free on purchase of 3 items

Effective price per item = ₹3x / 5

Discount = ₹x - ₹(3x / 5)

Discount = ₹x × (1 - 3/5)

Discount = ₹x × 0.40

4) 3 free on purchase of 7 items

Effective price per item = ₹7x / 10

Discount = ₹x - ₹(7x / 10)

Discount = ₹x × (1 - 7/10)

Discount = ₹x × 0.30

**The correct answer is option 4) Scheme 3.**
